zPDF 0.1.3

New

  • Bring Forward / Send Backward (Edit panel): move an object one step up or down past the object it overlaps, alongside Bring to Front / Send to Back.
  • Distribute Horizontally / Vertically: space three or more selected objects evenly.
  • Barcodes stay current: barcode fields regenerate automatically when you save, so they always match the form data.
  • Better automatic tagging on forms: numbered and bulleted lists on forms (side-by-side columns, spaced-out options) are tagged as proper lists, and stray numbered labels are no longer tagged as one-item lists.

Fixed

  • Hundreds of damaged or unusual real-world PDFs no longer cause “unexpected error” failures. Edits now either work or explain that part of the file is damaged — the document can still be viewed and printed.
  • PDFs with a malformed comment or annotation are no longer opened read-only.
  • Fonts with non-English names no longer break Reduce File Size, PDF/A or the Fonts list.
  • A crafted image in a PDF can no longer make an edit hang for minutes.

Install or update

  • Already installed: choose zPDF ▸ Check for Updates….
  • New install: download zPDF-0.1.3.dmg, open it, and drag zPDF to Applications.

Requires macOS 15 or later on an Apple silicon Mac.

zPDF 0.1.2

New

  • Report a Bug / Send a Suggestion (Help menu): tell the zPDF team what went wrong without leaving the app — no GitHub account needed. You can see exactly what's sent. Your email (optional) stays private, screenshots are optional, and your PDFs, file names and document text are never sent.
  • Error messages now have a Report… button that fills in the error for you.

Fixed

  • Signing with a certificate still failed on some PDFs (for example, files made by web-to-PDF converters such as wkhtmltopdf). Signing and certificate encryption now work on them.
  • Unexpected engine errors now include a short technical detail, so reports can be diagnosed quickly.

Install or update

  • Already installed: choose zPDF ▸ Check for Updates….
  • New install: download zPDF-0.1.2.dmg, open it, and drag zPDF to Applications.

Requires macOS 15 or later on an Apple silicon Mac.

zPDF 0.1.1

A fix release for testers of 0.1.0.

Fixed

  • Signing with a certificate failed ("The PDF engine could not complete this operation") on most PDFs exported from web browsers, Microsoft Office, Google Docs and design tools. Signing now works on those files, and so does encrypting a PDF for specific certificate recipients.
  • Better conversions to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, Markdown, RTF, XML and EPUB:
  • Labels inside drawings are no longer mistaken for tables, which dropped or scrambled words.
  • Map scale bars stay with their map.
  • Paragraphs that continue into the next column are kept together.
  • Words hyphenated at a line break are joined back up in reading-order formats.

Install or update

  • Already on 0.1.0: choose zPDF ▸ Check for Updates….
  • New install: download zPDF-0.1.1.dmg, open it, and drag zPDF to Applications.

Requires macOS 15 or later on an Apple silicon Mac.
